refnamediv.refpurpose: Separate numbers into complex-conjugate pairs and real values.

refsynopsisdiv.title: Syntax
refsynopsisdiv.synopsis: [zc, zr] = cplxreal(z) [zc, zr] = cplxreal(z, tol) [zc, zr] = cplxreal(z, tol, dim)

listitem.para: Vector or matrix. Input numbers to be separated.
Scalar. Tolerance for matching complex conjugates. Default is 100 * eps.
Integer. Dimension along which to sort. Default is the first non-singleton dimension.
Vector or matrix. Complex conjugate pairs.

refsection.title: Description
refsection.para: Sort the numbers z into complex-conjugate-valued and real-valued elements. The positive imaginary complex numbers of each complex conjugate pair are returned in zc and the real numbers are returned in zr. Signal an error if some complex numbers could not be paired. Signal an error if all complex numbers are not exact conjugates (to within tol). Note that there is no defined order for pairs with identical real parts but differing imaginary parts//
